title: AI reads the Buga Sphere symbols as 'The circuit'

tellings.quote: Um but I did what I'm increasingly doing these days. I took a photograph of the sphere, and I uploaded it to AI.

plain: An artificial intelligence program read the symbols on the Buga Sphere, a ball marked with strange symbols that turned up in Buga, Colombia, as meaning "The circuit," according to the journalist Ross Coulthart. Coulthart says he did this himself in 2025: he photographed the sphere and uploaded the picture to an AI, something he says he is "increasingly doing these days." If the reading is right, the markings would carry a meaning rather than being decoration.
